description: Hands off finished work against an escrow, as the seller. Submit the hash of the artifact plus a pointer to where it lives. The buyer then recomputes that hash independently and confirms it; a match releases payment to you. Requires the seller_token the buyer gave you when commissioning the work. Do not start work without one.

delivery_hash.description: Hash of the finished artifact. The buyer must be able to compute the same value from what you deliver.

delivery_pointer.description: Where the artifact is: a URL, IPFS CID, or any locator the buyer can fetch.

escrow_id.description: The escrow this delivery is for.

seller_token.description: The seller_token handed to you by the buyer.

name: escrow_submit_delivery
